alt_text: Two panels. Average gain: about 25 more minutes of sleep a night and 0.63 fewer wakings a night. More common with the tablets: memory problems and confusion, and daytime tiredness. From 24 trials in 2,417 people aged 60 and over.

Two small grids of person icons. About 1 in 13 more people reported better sleep than with a dummy pill (1 of 13 shaded). About 1 in 6 more people had a side effect of any kind (1 of 6 shaded). Different trials, so not the same people; a rough guide.
